lines.text: Amos takes up a lamentation over fallen Israel, and a city marching out a thousand strong will have a hundred left.
The LORD says to seek Him and live, and not to seek Bethel or journey to Hebron.
If they do not seek the LORD, He will sweep like fire through the house of Joseph.
Because they trample the poor and tax their grain, they will never live in the stone houses they built.
Perhaps the LORD will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph, but there will be wailing in all the fields.
